raw_segments.text: But to that there is to be added again, the duty of the foreign salt used curing a barrel of herring viz 0 12 6
So that the premium allowed for each barrel of her- rings entered for home consumption is £ 1 3 9 ¾
But to that there is to be added again. The duty of the foreign salt used currying a barrel of herring vis zero twelve six
So that the premium allowed for each barrel of her rings entered for home consumption is one three nine three quarters
But to that there is to be added again.
The duty of the foreign salt used currying a barrel of herring viz. 0-12-6, so that the
premium allowed for each barrel of her rings entered for home consumption, is 1-3-9-3-quarters.
